description: Source code for a recipe scraper class 'SpisBedre' that extracts recipe details from spisbedre.dk, including ingredients, instructions, equipment, nutrients, and metadata.

classes.name: SpisBedre
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from spisbedre.dk, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the scraper and loads recipe JSON data from the webpage.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Returns recipe categories/tags as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Returns total cooking time from schema.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the number of servings with proper singular/plural form.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of all ingredients by aggregating ingredient groups.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Processes and formats ingredient groups and their ingredients.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Returns a list of equipment used in the recipe.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of nutritional information.
